PROTOCOL PULSE — METRICS SEGMENT

Hashrate at 952.9 exahash. Fear index at 33 while transaction volume holds steady at 56,263—miners are accumulating conviction that retail panic is structural weakness, not signal. Watch mempool velocity at the next difficulty adjustment in 1,152 blocks.

The network is running price narrative hard. Long-form technical threads are getting buried under momentum chasing. Watch whether node operators shift discourse back to base layer capacity in the next 72 hours — that's your signal the market's entered price-discovery mode versus liquidity flush.

Hash rate is the most honest signal in Bitcoin. Miners don't speculate — they commit capital, electricity, and hardware. When hash rate climbs to all-time highs, it means serious operators are betting their balance sheets on Bitcoin's future.
